headline: 1.1 is with Apple: Around Town, the dim-light photo modes, Premium Lifetime and crash reports, submitted today at 4:16 PM with its 16 new screenshots. 1.0 is on sale; prices rise to $29.99 and $3.99 on Oct 2.

numbers.label: First opens
numbers.detail: real users, release builds; the first came on 30 Sep, launch day

numbers.label: Purchases
numbers.detail: both paywalls; the only learner so far is in the under-13 or unanswered tier

needsYou.title: Upload-Post yearly plan, and connect TikTok
needsYou.detail: The app is on sale, so the daily lesson videos can start. The last thing waiting is the paid Upload-Post plan and TikTok on the softroni profile. Once they're in, Claude installs the 17:00 launch agent.

needsYou.title: Don't publish Paywall 1 or Flow 1 in Superwall yet
needsYou.detail: They have Lifetime as drafts. Publishing before 1.1 is on sale would sell Lifetime to 1.0, which doesn't unlock it. Claude publishes them after approval.

working.title: 1.1 release
working.detail: Submitted 2026-09-30 4:16 PM with Premium Lifetime; waiting for review. Phased release after approval.

working.title: Apple Ads, first days
working.detail: 4 campaigns created Wednesday: Brand $1, Category $5, Competitors $2, Discovery $2 (broad and search match), US, iPhone and iPad. On hold until Apple finishes categorizing the new app (APP_NOT_CATEGORIZED), usually within a day or two.

working.title: First real learners
working.detail: The first open from the App Store came in Wednesday morning: onboarding done in 24 seconds, then a Pine Tree drawing finished. No crashes or hangs.

working.title: Lesson videos on social
working.detail: Private test on Monday: YouTube Shorts posted, and Facebook Reels posted on the second try. Public posting starts with the paid plan (see Needs you).

working.title: Keyword baseline
working.detail: Where Paper Coach ranks for its keywords in its first days, so later changes can be measured.

log.text: Submitted 1.1 (4) with Premium Lifetime (Kevin's go-ahead): both Waiting for Review, phased release after approval

1.1 (4) ready to submit: 393 iOS and 758 web tests pass, walkthrough done, build uploaded (VALID) and attached, text and 16 screenshots in App Store Connect (shot 4 now the finished fire hydrant), Lifetime Ready to Submit. Waiting for Kevin's Submit

1.1 in App Store Connect (Prepare for Submission): text, keywords, review notes, phased release, 16 screenshots uploaded; Lifetime availability saved (175). Waiting on the plans-sheet subtitle fix, then build and QA
Lifetime added to Superwall (product 679735) and to designs 1 and 3 under View more plans, as drafts until 1.1 is on sale; stale onboarding test fixed; iPad shots say Around Town

Built next-builds item 5 on main (a69946e): Premium Lifetime ($99.99 non-consumable, counted as Premium bought, family-shared or from a code) as the third row of View more plans, and Settings > Premium > Redeem a code (grown-ups' check for a child). Events offer_code_sheet_opened and premium_from_code. 1.1's boxes are all ticked. The simulator asks the App Store sandbox, so the Lifetime row shows there only once App Store Connect serves the product (availability still to set).
1.1 prep: store text drafted (listing.md), Lifetime product checked, iPad Paths and Home screenshots show Urban. Waiting on Lifetime in the app

Built next-builds item 4 on main (6ae5669): learners 13 and over are asked for an App Store rating two seconds after a finished drawing, from their third on, never in their first session, at most once per version per device; never a child, the first run, screenshots or tests. rating_prompt_requested goes to PostHog. Ships with 1.1; 1.1's third box is ticked.

Built next-builds item 1 on main (508ec63): any product in Premium's subscription group 22413930 now unlocks Premium, purchase_attempted reports a product's plan by its period, and 'Your free week has started' names the price of the product the week began on. Ships with 1.1; 1.1's second box is ticked. Until 1.1 is on sale, no new product may go on a paywall.
Prices: $29.99/year and $3.99/week for new subscribers from Oct 2 (set by Kevin, all 175 storefronts, existing subscribers keep theirs); repo updated
Kevin added Crash Data and Performance Data to App Privacy. 1.0.1 dropped: 1.1 carries it, with Urban, the photo modes and next-builds items 1 and 4 (docs/releases/1.1.md)
First real learner: onboarding finished, then a Pine Tree drawing; no crashes
Apple Ads: 4 campaigns live, US, $10 a day (Brand $1, Category $5, Competitors $2, Discovery $2), with keywords and exclusions per apple-ads-plan.md; serving waits for Apple to categorize the app
Tagged afa25bc as 1.0(2) and pushed the tag
Apple approved 1.0 (2); Paper Coach is on the App Store (READY_FOR_DISTRIBUTION)
Daily check: 1.0 (2) still waiting for review; no reviews, sales, crashes or PostHog traffic yet. Ads wait for approval.

Lesson videos: Lina now ends on 'Draw more with Paper Coach. It's free on the App Store.' ('free to download' for Premium lessons), her closing line is captioned, and stickers of the path's next lessons land round the drawing instead of an 8 s still frame (d2c81d4)

Paths now have their own colors, set in the Studio (Edit details… or `studio paths color`). Lesson videos use their path's color as the background, and the app will use the same colors from the next release. Plants is green, Sky & Weather blue. App Store screenshots 2, 3, 5, 6 and 8 were taken again. Pushed 29372d8; nothing was submitted to Apple.

Lesson videos: layout moved clear of YouTube's buttons and channel line (measured on the test Short), and Lina's words now show 2–3 at a time on one big line with the spoken word in yellow, timed by Whisper (ef650b7).
Built on main at the creator's request: Edit on a sketchbook page, to change its light (Original / Bright / Scan) and corners later (ecea871). Not released.
Built on main at the creator's request: Original / Bright / Scan for sketchbook photos taken in dim light (c33ada7). Not released.

Social: lesson videos now post through Upload-Post to Softroni's accounts (studio social). Tested privately on YouTube and a Facebook draft; public posts, and the daily 17:00 job, wait for Paper Coach to go on sale.
